postUpgradeTasks.description: Re-encrypt values.yaml after Renovate bumps an image tag. These files are decrypted to plaintext by the runner's boot.sh BEFORE Renovate extracts/edits them (Renovate has no preUpgradeTasks hook, and a post-edit decrypt would fail: editing a SOPS file invalidates its mac). So by the time this task runs, the file is plaintext and `sops -e -i` safely rebuilds a valid SOPS document carrying the bumped tag. branch mode re-encrypts each changed file once, after all deps on the branch are updated.
